tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Scaffold background behind every screen. Same values as the web platform.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, the nav bar, list rows.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: time-control tiles, inputs, chips, the idle clock, move-list ribbon.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state, skeleton loaders, a selected neutral chip. Never put ink-3 on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows; card edges in the dark theme.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that define a control: outline button, unfilled input, checkbox. 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-2 and surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, metadata, idle nav labels. Legible on bg, surface, surface-2, surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, hints. On bg, surface and surface-2 only (fails on surface-3).

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Hamduk green as a fixed brand colour: woven strip, hero gradient start, app icon. Does not change with theme.

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Hamduk gold as a fixed brand colour: woven strip and cover. Does not change with theme.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active tab, links, selection, focus ring. As text on bg, surface, surface-2 and green-soft.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill (primary button label). Dark text in the dark theme because green lightens there.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind green text: selected chip, current move in the move list, win pill.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Reward and premium fill: the Play button, the current rating milestone, the Plus badge, rating gains. One gold fill per screen. Never body text.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold as text (rating gain, streak count) on bg, surface, surface-2 and gold-soft.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind gold-ink: rating-gain pill, streak badge.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Deep brand ground for hero cards and the gradient's end; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: forest-raised
tokens.usage: A raised element sitting on forest, such as a tile inside a hero card.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on forest and on the hero gradient.

tokens.name: on-forest-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on forest and anywhere on the hero gradient (4.7:1 at its lightest point).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive icons, the live dot, the low-time clock. The light value is the web's brand red: white text on it is only 4.1:1, so text and button fills use danger-ink.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a danger-ink fill (the confirm-resign button).

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Destructive text and the fill of the destructive button. On bg, surface and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger-ink: loss pill, error banner.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: A won game: result pill text and rating gain lines. Always paired with W or the word.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: A lost game. Always paired with L or the word.

tokens.name: draw
tokens.usage: A drawn game. Always paired with D or the word.

tokens.name: board-light
tokens.usage: Light squares of the Hamduk board (default). Coordinates on these squares use board-dark.

tokens.name: board-dark
tokens.usage: Dark squares of the Hamduk board. 4.6:1 against black pieces. Coordinates on these squares use board-light.

tokens.name: board-last-move
tokens.usage: Overlay on the from and to squares of the last move.

tokens.name: board-selected
tokens.usage: Overlay on the picked-up piece's square and on a hint square.

tokens.name: board-move-dot
tokens.usage: Legal-move dot (16% of a square) and capture ring (8% stroke).

tokens.name: board-premove
tokens.usage: Overlay on queued premove squares; adire indigo so it never reads as a real move.

tokens.name: board-check
tokens.usage: Centre of the radial glow under a king in check, fading to transparent at the square's edge.

tokens.name: board-arrow
tokens.usage: Hint and analysis arrows.

tokens.name: board-classic-light
tokens.usage: Classic board option, light squares (the app's previous board).

tokens.name: board-classic-dark
tokens.usage: Classic board option, dark squares.

tokens.name: board-adire-light
tokens.usage: Adire board option (Hamduk Plus), light squares.

tokens.name: board-adire-dark
tokens.usage: Adire board option (Hamduk Plus), dark squares; 4.5:1 against black pieces.

tokens.name: stage-mint
tokens.usage: Portrait stage for bots rated up to 1000. The portrait multiplies onto it so its white backdrop takes this colour.

tokens.name: stage-sand
tokens.usage: Portrait stage for bots rated 1200 to 1600.

tokens.name: stage-clay
tokens.usage: Portrait stage for bots rated 1800 to 2200.

tokens.name: stage-indigo
tokens.usage: Portrait stage for bots rated 2400 and up.

tokens.name: review-book
tokens.usage: Book move badge fill; glyph on-review.

tokens.name: review-best
tokens.usage: Best move badge fill; glyph on-review.

tokens.name: review-good
tokens.usage: Good move badge fill; glyph on-review.

tokens.name: review-great
tokens.usage: Great move (!) badge fill; glyph on-review.

tokens.name: review-brilliant
tokens.usage: Brilliant move (!!) badge fill; glyph on-review.

tokens.name: review-miss
tokens.usage: Miss (?!) badge fill; glyph on-review.

tokens.name: review-inaccuracy
tokens.usage: Inaccuracy (?!) badge fill; glyph on-review-dark.

tokens.name: review-mistake
tokens.usage: Mistake (?) badge fill; glyph on-review-dark.

tokens.name: review-blunder
tokens.usage: Blunder (??) badge fill; glyph on-review.

tokens.name: on-review
tokens.usage: Glyph on book, best, good and blunder badges.

tokens.name: on-review-dark
tokens.usage: Glyph on inaccuracy and mistake badges.

families.sans: "DM Sans", "Noto Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Result headlines and onboarding. Fixed copy only, never user names.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Large screen titles on the five main tabs.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Bottom-sheet and section-hero titles. The smallest size Playfair is allowed.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Card titles, player names on profile, compact app bar title.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: List-row titles, banner text, tile titles.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Persona names, player bar names, small card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Clubs in Ṣàgámù, Ọ̀yọ́ and Ìbàdàn
styles.usage: Default running text. Letters DM Sans lacks (ẹ ọ ṣ ɓ ɗ ƙ, ₦) fall back to Noto Sans.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Lagos Island · Street smart, chess dumb

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels above content. Always uppercase.

styles.name: rating-xl
styles.usage: The headline rating on profile and puzzle hero. Tabular figures.

styles.name: rating-md
styles.usage: Ratings in rows, chips and the result sheet. Tabular figures.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The game clock in a player bar. Tabular by design.

styles.name: clock-sm
styles.usage: Clocks in spectate lists and the local-tournament board.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a chip or badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related items: player bar and board, chips in a row, lines in a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in a grid; list row inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet padding; hero card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space below a ScreenHeader before content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Top padding on onboarding and sign-in panels.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Clock pill, review badge, small count badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, segmented controls, avatar squircles at 40px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, time-control tiles, list groups, large buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero cards; top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Onboarding and sign-in panels.

tokens.name: radius-board
tokens.usage: Board corners where the board sits inside a gutter (puzzles, previews). Edge-to-edge boards are square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: badges, result pills, rating chips.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and tiles. In the dark theme it is a hairline edge, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the result sheet, a dragged piece.

tokens.name: shadow-gold
tokens.usage: The one current thing on a screen: the current milestone, the tile being searched, the active Play button.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus on any control: a 2px gap in bg, then a solid 2px green ring.

size.note: Fixed component dimensions in logical pixels (Flutter dp).

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-button-lg
tokens.usage: Large button height: the one main action on a screen.

tokens.name: size-button-md
tokens.usage: Default button height.

tokens.name: size-button-sm
tokens.usage: Small button height inside cards and banners.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Compact app bar height on pushed screens.

tokens.name: size-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar height (plus the system inset).

tokens.name: size-player-bar
tokens.usage: Player bar height above and below the board.

tokens.name: size-tc-tile
tokens.usage: Time-control tile height (4 tiles per row from 360dp wide, 3 below).

tokens.name: size-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatar in dense lists and chat.

tokens.name: size-avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatar in list rows and player bars.

tokens.name: size-avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar on profile headers.

tokens.name: size-strip
tokens.usage: Height of the woven strip.
